Privacy policy

Last updated: 23 October 2026

Information we collect

We collect only the minimum information needed to provide this site. Depending on your preferences, this may include technical browsing data and browser identifiers, cookies.

How we use it

We use information to improve content clarity, understand general usage patterns where you have accepted analytics, meet applicable legal obligations.

Third-party services

The site may use Google Maps for the embedded map and Google Analytics only if you enable analytics cookies. These providers operate under their own policies. Google Fonts receives font requests. Cloudflare hosts the site and may inject a performance/RUM beacon, separate from the Analytics choice and not managed by this control.

Your rights

Under the GDPR and applicable rules, you may request access to, correction or erasure of personal data, object to certain processing, and lodge a complaint with the relevant authority where applicable.
